propositions: Project overlays can only define standalone project.* criteria and cannot extend built-in overlay triggers; the registry reads committed routing but ignores project-level trigger extensions.

A project overlay entry keyed by a built-in overlay ID must support additive trigger_tokens (substring matches on diff lines) and applies_to globs (unioned with committed globs) without replacing committed trigger logic.

The helper function project_trigger_extensions must read project overlay raw code_review entries directly and return per-overlay-id lists of trigger_tokens and applies_to globs to be unioned at consumption.
glob_triggered_overlays and content_triggered_overlays must union project-level trigger extensions with committed triggers; effective_routing remains unchanged and governs only thresholds/postures.
Malformed project entries (non-list trigger_tokens, non-string tokens, unknown overlay IDs) must be silently ignored without raising exceptions.
With no project overlay present, both trigger functions must produce identical results to current behavior; pre-existing tests must pass unmodified.
